result.title: A Piecewise-Linear Activation Function for Implicit Neural Representations
result.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027. Code: https://github.com/jeovafarias/jasin
result.summary: Coordinate networks with ReLU activations perform poorly on implicit neural representation tasks, and the activations that address this, such as sinusoids and Gabor wavelets, all leave the piecewise-linear function class, so it remains unclear which property of ReLU is at fault. We introduce JaSIN, a family of bounded piecewise-linear activations that interpolates between ReLU and a piecewise-linear sinusoid without any the use of transcendental operation. Our results show that a bounded range improves image reconstruction PSNR on average by 0.06 dB, a single bump 3.29 dB, and centering that bump a further 3.64 dB. The oscillation count improves 6.30 dB more, raising ReLU from 24.0 to 37.3 dB on Kodak images, placing third over eleven activations, within 1.3 dB of the state-of-the-art, though beyond four oscillations the reconstruction collapses. Because an INR is fit on the grid on which it is evaluated, a unit whose pre-activations never reach the support of its activation is certifiably inactive over the entire domain; deleting such units is lossless without fine-tuning, removing up to 84% of parameters at zero loss in performance (dB) and decoding 3.2 times faster. Reference code and demos are available at https://github.com/jeovafarias/jasin.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 JaSIN——一类有界分段线性激活函数，在 ReLU 与分段线性正弦之间插值，用于坐标网络式隐式表示；实验考察有界性、单峰与峰居中、振荡次数对图像重建 PSNR 的影响，并利用 INR 仅在评估网格上拟合的性质无损失地删除可证不活跃单元。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其有界分段线性激活与「振荡次数」控制可供核查：内部表示中视觉细节的保留与频谱容量是否受激活形式约束；「前激活不触及激活支撑即可证单元在整个域上不活跃」的论证，也可能为判断 latent 或单元是否实际参与输出、贡献分配提供一种可验证的静态判据。
